core_obligations: Retain original pseudohermitian U(2) geometry, regular/periodic/unit-speed assumptions, quotient by reparametrization and constant phase rotation, exact period and curvature normalization.

Retain complete nonconstant stationary cnoidal/dnoidal moduli and exclusion of degenerate cnoidal case, lambda positivity, generic and exceptional eigenvectors and original domain J=R or R minus h omega, exact two rational quantum closure and time-evolution conditions. Experimental level-set observations, examples and outlook not upgraded or counted.
difficulty_reason: For nonconstant stationary curves the author uses conserved Hermitian momentum, proves global eigenvector independence with explicit generic and exceptional cnoidal/dnoidal cases, derives scalar integrating factors and the Frenet-frame quadrature, and obtains closure and rigid time evolution. These nonroutine reconstruction obligations remain one independent group with exact source-local domains.
